title: FBI-UAP-D014, Correspondence Relating to UFO Sightings, 1967, 1974
doc_notes: This document consists of FBI correspondence regarding UFO inquiries, including one mention of a historical occupant report from 1954.

encounters.summary: A researcher requests FBI files regarding a 1954 incident where a UFO allegedly landed, and an occupant exited the craft and walked around before departing, witnessed by three civilians and pursued by Coast Guard personnel.
encounters.quote: landed briefly on the ground (discharging the occupant, who stroll about and returned to the object)
